parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the toilet, made of polypropylene plastic, shaped to fit the bowl and provide comfort for the user.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and hygienic surface for sitting during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge to allow access to the bowl.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A flush button located on the top of the tank, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet, made of polypropylene plastic, covers the seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover to maintain hygiene and improve appearance when the toilet is not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge, similar to the seat.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Cover)
parts.Basic_description: The top cover of the toilet tank, made of ceramic, fits snugly over the tank opening.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing mechanism and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toilet, made of vitreous china ceramic, includes the bowl and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component anchored to the floor.
